digest.component_or_area: LLM framework structured output with prompt caching
propositions: Direct Anthropic structured cache canary executes two identical-prefix calls (write then read) with correct usage accounting: call 1 shows cache_write_tokens=10697 and cache_read_tokens=0; call 2 shows cache_read_tokens=10697 and cache_write_tokens=0

Bedrock structured cache canary executes the same two-call sequence with matching cache behavior: call 1 writes 10685 tokens, call 2 reads 10685 tokens, with identical uncached token count (62) on both providers

Observed complete-vs-omit branch on both providers shows the COMPLETE path taken (1 message in, 1 kept, 0 omitted) on all four calls; OMIT branch unexercised because no failed output responses existed to project

Observed accounting matches documented contract in docs/llm-framework.md: exactly one outer run per call, zero transport retries, no downgrade, inclusive-input convention confirmed across both providers

Mixed-provider fallback chain collapses prompt caching to 'none' due to non-interchangeable cache keys between providers, documented in rebar.toml and runner_support._intersect_capabilities but not mentioned in llm-framework.md accounting section
